parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:
You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no next query exists.
If a next query exists, set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值：20

parameters.help_en:
The zone ID of the Application Load Balancing (ALB) instance.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189196.html operation to query the active zone information
parameters.help_zh:
应用型负载均衡实例所在的可用区ID。

parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance status of the Application Load Balancing (ALB) instance. Valid values:

Inactive: The instance is stopped. Listeners no longer forward traffic.

Active: The instance is running.

Provisioning: The instance is being created.

Configuring: Upgrade/Downgrade in progress.

CreateFailed: The instance failed to be created. In this case, no fees are incurred. You can only delete the instance. The system cleans up instances that failed to be created in the last day by default
parameters.help_zh:
应用型负载均衡实例状态。取值：

Inactive： 已停止，监听不再转发流量。

Active:：运行中。

Provisioning：创建中。

Configuring：变配中。

CreateFailed：创建失败，此时不会产生费用，实例只能被删除。系统默认清理最近1天创建失败的实例
parameters.name: load_balancer_status

parameters.help_en:
The business status of the Application Load Balancing (ALB) instance. Valid values:

Abnormal: The instance is abnormal.

Normal: The instance is running as expected
parameters.help_zh:
应用型负载均衡的业务状态。取值：

Abnormal：异常。

Normal：正常
parameters.name: load_balancer_bussiness_status

parameters.help_zh: 实例ID列表。最多支持20个应用型负载均衡实例ID
parameters.name: load_balancer_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of instance names. You can specify up to 10 instance names

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the instance. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
实例的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the instance. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
实例的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。一旦输入该值，可以为空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The address type of the instance. Valid values:

Internet: The load balancing instance has a public IP address. The DNS domain name is resolved to the public IP address. Therefore, the instance can be accessed over the Internet.

Intranet: The load balancing instance has only a private IP. The DNS domain name is resolved to the private IP. Therefore, the instance can be accessed only within the internal network environment of the VPC where the load balancing instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh:
实例地址类型。取值：

Internet：负载均衡具有公网IP地址，DNS域名被解析到公网IP，因此可以在公网环境访问。

Intranet：负载均衡只有私网IP地址，DNS域名被解析到私网IP，因此只能被负载均衡所在VPC的内网环境访问
parameters.name: address_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

PostPay (default): the pay-as-you-go billing method
parameters.help_zh:
实例的计费类型。取值：

PostPay（默认值）：表示按量计费
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The protocol version. Valid values:

IPv4: IPv4.
DualStack: dual stack
parameters.help_zh:
协议版本。取值：

IPv4：IPv4类型。
DualStack：双栈类型
parameters.name: address_ip_version

Intranet: The load balancing instance has only a private IP. The DNS domain name is resolved to the private IP. Therefore, the instance can be accessed only within the internal network environment of the VPC where the load balancing instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh:
应用型负载均衡的IPv6地址类型。取值：

Reason.description_en:
The reason for enabling modification protection.

The value must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The value must start with a letter.

This parameter is returned only when Status is set to ConsoleProtection
Reason.description_zh:
开启修改保护的原因。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以大小写英文字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。

仅在Status为ConsoleProtection时返回
Reason.title_en: 设置修改保护状态的原因
Reason.title_zh: 设置修改保护状态的原因

Status.description_en:
The modification protection status of the Application Load Balancing (ALB) instance. Valid values:

NonProtection: Modification protection is disabled. If Reason is configured, Reason is forcefully cleared.

ConsoleProtection: Console-based modification protection is enabled. If Reason is configured, Reason takes effect.

When the value is ConsoleProtection, you cannot modify the instance configuration in the load balancing console, but you can call API operations to modify the instance configuration
Status.description_zh:
应用型负载均衡实例的修改保护状态。取值：

NonProtection：未开启修改保护。如有配置Reason，Reason会被强制置空。

ConsoleProtection：已开启控制台修改保护。如有配置Reason，Reason可生效。

当取值为ConsoleProtection，即开启修改保护后，用户不能通过负载均衡控制台修改实例配置，但可以通过调用API修改实例配置
